faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Why do I need to verify my identity?
faq.a1: International regulations require identity verification for all money transfers — both personal (P2P) and business (B2B). This is handled by Bridge (MSB registered with FinCEN, USA), not OmniPay. It's a one-time process — you'll never have to do it again.
faq.q2: How long does the transfer take?
faq.a2: Personal transfer (P2P): Near-instant — Bridge processes the payment to any of the 41+ destination countries in minutes. Business payment (B2B): 4–5 business days (Stripe+Wise) or 1–2 business days (Bridge Wire, subject to availability).
faq.q3: Does OmniPay store my banking details or documents?
faq.a3: No — not for personal or business transfers. OmniPay does not store banking details, documents, or credentials. Only Bridge (the regulated provider) processes them using AES-256 encryption.
faq.q4: What if I close the page after completing KYC?
faq.a4: For personal transfers (P2P): return to the original link — the system will detect your completed verification and continue automatically. For business payments (B2B): same — return to the payment link and the system picks up where you left off.
faq.a5: Personal transfer (P2P): OmniPay 0.50% + $0.49 flat · Bridge ~0.75% conversion · No FX markup. Business B2B via Bridge Wire: same as P2P. Business B2B via Stripe+Wise: Stripe 2.9% + Wise ~0.5% + OmniPay 1%. We use the real market rate — no hidden FX spread.
faq.q6: What happens if there is a technical failure during the transfer?
faq.a6: If the system fails at any point before Bridge confirms the final payment, the funds are automatically returned to the sender. Nothing is left stranded: Bridge does not release money until it confirms the recipient received it. If the issue persists, contact our support from the home page.
